description: The single receipt format for the Neuruh estate (convergence spec items 3 and 76). One chain format for observation, forecast, outcome, gate, promotion, verification, anchor, and build receipts. A receipt is a chained, hash-linked record: receipt_hash is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the receipt with receipt_hash and receipt_id removed (receipt_id is defined to equal receipt_hash, so it cannot be part of its own hash input). prev_hash links to the previous receipt's receipt_hash, or GENESIS for the first receipt in a chain. Every major receipt carries the current manifest Merkle root (merkle_root) and, once an anchor exists, the on-chain anchored root (anchor_root). A record hash (for example a forecast's own receipt, or an observation_id) lives inside payload, not as the receipt itself: the canonical receipt wraps the record hash and chains it. This schema is implemented in verify.js (browser) and receipts.py (Python); the two must produce identical hashes.

verification_receipt.receipt_hash: <sha256 of canonical receipt without receipt_hash and receipt_id>

hashing_rule.canonical_json: JSON, keys sorted bytewise, separators (',', ':'), no whitespace, UTF-8. Python: json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False). JS: AnchorVerify.canonicalStringify.
hashing_rule.chain_rule: receipts[i].prev_hash must equal receipts[i-1].receipt_hash; receipts[0].prev_hash must be GENESIS.
hashing_rule.receipt_hash: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the receipt object with the receipt_hash and receipt_id fields removed. All other fields, including prev_hash, are included, so the hash binds the chain.
hashing_rule.receipt_id: Defined to equal receipt_hash. Set after computing receipt_hash.

actor.description: Who or what issued the receipt: a tool name and version (for example anchor-v2), a page name, or a human authorizer (for example 'Jeramie Hicks (human)').

anchor_root.description: The on-chain anchored root. Null until a real anchor exists (finish criterion 2 is BLOCKED pending Jeramie's chain/wallet choice).

merkle_root.description: The current manifest Merkle root (the full root over all leaves) at issuance. Null only when no manifest exists yet.

payload.description: Action-specific data. Must contain the record's own hash where one exists (for example observation_id for an observation, record_hash for a forecast, root for a verification).

prev_hash.description: The previous receipt's receipt_hash in the same chain, or the literal string GENESIS for the first receipt.

receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this receipt with receipt_hash and receipt_id removed. Canonical JSON: keys sorted bytewise, separators (',', ':'), no whitespace, UTF-8.

receipt_id.description: The receipt's identifier. Defined to equal receipt_hash.

receipt_version.description: The canonical receipt schema version. Distinct from the verifier tool version (2.0.0) and the manifest schema version (2.0).

root.description: Optional. The root the verification was checked against (for a membership check; equals merkle_root for a fresh receipt).

verifier_version.description: Optional. The verifier tool version that issued the receipt (for example 2.0.0).

title: Neuruh canonical verification receipt schema v1.1
